name: ordering
description: ADR-0023's watermark rules over moneta's monotonic stamps: revokes_session is login_iat <= toe; disables_link is toe >= last_login_iat (otherwise acknowledged without being applied); reenables_link is login_iat > disabled toe. set_iat is informational: no rule reads it.

ordering.note: a session from before the cause is revoked
a stale session-revoked spares a newer session
account-disabled applies when no newer login exists
a stale account-disabled after a re-add is acknowledged without being applied
a login at the disabled toe does not re-enable
a redriven SET (fresh iat, old toe) is still stale to the newer session
